rationale: My round-4 hard block is cleared by independent re-derivation at reviewed commit 0f7f2216ba36abe35604e35be63fc57448e75e47. In a disposable clone whose path and real branch both modeled a spec worktree, I drove the real ReadState -> Run(pre-commit) path under both required session variants. With no session and with a claimed-bead session, healthy lifecycle discovery produced ModeImplement and Block; changing only discovery to fail produced a non-nil ModeIndeterminate and Block. The indeterminate message is honest: it says the lifecycle mode cannot be determined, identifies bd/Dolt discovery failure or unresolved ambiguity, recommends mindspec doctor, and preserves the deliberate escape hatch without claiming the mode is implement. The focused internal/hook suite passed, make build completed (with a non-fatal Go module-cache permission warning), and the bead worktree remained byte-identical. A broader go test ./... -short attempt was infrastructure-blocked by no-space-left-on-device failures across unrelated linker and temp-directory operations; this does not contradict the focused passing evidence. No spec-branch-corrupting defect remains in the reviewed fix.

findings.title: Prior ask 1: fail closed honestly on indeterminate spec-branch state
findings.evidence: internal/hook/dispatch.go now handles state.ModeIndeterminate on spec/* before the literal implement-mode branch and returns Block. The observed text begins "mindspec: cannot determine lifecycle mode for spec branch 'spec/999-fixture-spec' — refusing a direct commit while the mode is indeterminate." It then names bd/Dolt discovery failure or unresolved ambiguity, directs the user to mindspec doctor, and documents the existing MINDSPEC_ALLOW_MAIN escape hatch.

findings.title: Prior ask 2: real-path regression coverage across session variants
findings.evidence: The independent clone probe reran TestPreCommit_SpecBranch_IndeterminateFailsClosed through real ReadState and Run. no_session: healthy mode=implement/action=Block; failure mode=indeterminate/action=Block. claimed_bead_session: healthy mode=implement/action=Block; failure mode=indeterminate/action=Block. All four subtests passed, and the committed regression test preserves the same crossed matrix.

findings.title: Broad short-suite attempt exhausted host disk space
findings.evidence: go test ./... -short -count=1 could not complete because unrelated packages and the Go linker repeatedly failed to create outputs and TempDirs with no space left on device. Before that attempt, go test ./internal/hook -count=1 passed; the exact four-way disposable-clone probe also passed; make build completed.
